item.title: Today, for #WorldPhotographyDay, we’re welcoming Melissa Auf d...
item.description: Today, for #WorldPhotographyDay, we’re welcoming Melissa Auf der Maur, who’s just arrived to install her exhibition Melissa Auf der Maur: My ‘9s Rock Photographs, which opens in September at the AGO. Made up of intimate photographs that celebrate the independent spirit of the ‘9s, it offers an insider’s view of the decade before smartphones and digital recording. Through a selection of more than photographs, the show explores a moving self-portrait of a young artist living through the ‘9s music scene, a time capsule of Generation X and a reference for future generations. Come see the ‘9s through @xmadmx’s lens.    Members’ Access: Sept –7  Annual Pass Access: Sept 5–7  Public Access: Sept 8Not a Member or an Annual Passholder? Become one today and see the exhibition as soon as it opens!

item.title: Melissa Auf der Maur took fans of ’9s alt-rock connoisseurs Sm...
item.description: Melissa Auf der Maur took fans of ’9s alt-rock connoisseurs Smashing Pumpkins by surprise in June last year when she re-emerged on stage in her native Montréal.Wielding her trusty P-Bass, she joined Billy Corgan and the Machines to hold down the low-end on The Everlasting Gaze.Last year’s brief reunion with Corgan wasn’t a one-off, however. Auf der Maur’s memoir, Even the Good Girls Will Cry, released earlier this year, kicked off a conversation that led to the bassist joining the Pumpkins on stage at Lollapalooza this past weekend.“Part of me accepting the invitation was testing the theory that music is like riding a bike... the heartbeat and rhythmic feel is eternal. The fingers need a little awakening and refreshing, but otherwise I am ready.”Full story link in bio : Samuel Dietz/WireImage

item.title: LOLLAPALOOZA Time TravelRewind —— Lolla 1994, over three dec...
item.description: LOLLAPALOOZA Time TravelRewind —— Lolla 1994, over three decades ago, I was on the guest list for the Montreal show to see my friend (and inspo / mentor) @billycorgan band @smashingpumpkins play that day … they were headlining…. that day he told me that he recommended me to his friend @courtneylove who was seeking a new bass player …. safe to say that was the radical gateway to the rest of my music mania life.HereNowChicagoXLolla 6. I join, the now, again, headliners (3 years later?!) for their last song — bass x body x past, moves me deep within … awaken gateway.BONS TRACK: fellow Piscean poet songstress @oliviarodrigo joined for a song, amplifying our generational music / spirit connections.Floating and GratefulI miss my bass, I miss you out there, the listeners and receivers … to say nothing of my fellow misfit poet musicians who have crystallized such inner crevasses of my life xo@courtneylove @billycorgan @chamberdrums @jamesihaofficial @smashingpumpkins @pattyschemel #ericerlandson @holemusicHole x Pumpkins Karmic mashup eternal pour moi … 1st century future style.YES I AM A HIPPY TRIPPY FREAK(and I believe in ghosts, magic and astrology)xMxP.S. The Rivera warm up show, on the Full Buck Moon / Lion’s Gateway, part Wednesday felt like an actual psychedelic time travel portal to me … I’ll be reporting from the others side here, and on my new 1st Century Diary - Substack (link in bio)P.P.S. Hole x Lolla 1995 tour was one of the best of my life - I wrote a whole chapter about it in My 9s Rock Memoir (out now!) and have many photos of it in my upcoming photobook and exhibit coming in Sept!More. Time. Travel.Photos/Videos: @ertok @kindergrrrl @tyliner

item.title: She Sells Substack6 is the year of unveiling and unearthing of m...
item.description: She Sells Substack6 is the year of unveiling and unearthing of my archives from the last analog decade (aka my music x soul activation)My 9s rock memoir, come photographs exhibit and book, come soundtrack, come MORE AKA SBSTACK.I’m a pro-human, pro-analog, photographer, bass player, mother, believer - and in honor of this significant year of unveiling, I’ve created a new place where the stories can expand: never before told secrets, memories, photographs, journals, playlists, pilgrimages, conversations, and more yet to be discovered and found along the way.My ’9s Rock Photographs book and exhibit finally makes its way into the world this September, but *** only images from my 15, photographic archives are included in the book / exhibit *** so as you can imagine, there is many more where that comes from.For those who wanna go deeper, come find me…Head to the link in bio for my NEW NEWSLETTERGrateful for the innate desire within to share, and for your willingness to witness out there.xMxSeashells on the Seashore field-trip to Cape Cod family roots this past week.Took a dip into the ocean and Provincetown to hug heroic queens @Ryanmcginleystudios and @roddybottum at @theoldbabyprovincetown (unveiled the new book and pro-human merchandise - coming soon to xMAdMx Shop! Stay tuned!)
